header: Customer ratings for six parts of our service
lead: Six questions on a five-point scale. Since 2024, two scores have improved and one has fallen: value for money.
note: 2,400 replies from 9,000 customers surveyed in September 2026. The overall score is the weighted figure from the annual report; the rows are unweighted means.

metrics.title: Online portal
metrics.text: Up from 3.9 in 2024, after the rebuild.

metrics.title: Value for money
metrics.text: Down from 3.7 in 2024. Prices rose 11 % over the same period.
